versions.changelog:
Initial release — turn Etherscan transaction data into clear, independently-verifiable execution stories.

- Analyze and explain up to two EVM transactions using live Etherscan data with direct, auditable explorer links.
- Support deep evidence gathering: transaction, receipt, internal calls, contract/proxy/ABI data, logs, asset movements, and permission changes.
- Smart audience targeting (simple, standard, developer, support, security) with tailored explanations and confidence levels.
- Explicit evidence rules and rigorous boundaries: never invent intent, distinguish observed vs. derived vs. inferred facts, warn about missing or partial data.
- Etherscan-first positioning to help users directly confirm claims, without overstating trace or verification capabilities.
